citation: User engineering policy: Imax = margin_factor × peak|measured I|; Vmax = margin_factor × max(|measured V|, |R I + L dI/dt| from measured I with cited R/L). 20% headroom above the governing envelope. Not inventing plant ratings — explicit declared envelope for feedforward planning.
notes: Edit margin_factor here before a run to change headroom (e.g. 1.1 or 1.5). V envelope includes circuit-dynamics needs so tracking measured I remains feasible. Fixed per-circuit Imax/Vmax can replace this policy by setting limit_policy to fixed and filling circuits. Resolved numeric limits are snapshotted under inputs/coil_limits_authority/ after each planner run.
